subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should OpenClaw add a Feishu/account-level `ignoreFileContent` setting, or should inbound file-text suppression be solved through a shared media/file-extraction control?
rationale: The reported behavior is real in source, but the named setting is not a current contract and adding config surface needs maintainer ownership and compatibility judgment.

options.title: Add a documented suppression control
options.body: Implement a Feishu-scoped or shared inbound file-text suppression setting with docs, schema metadata, and regression coverage for placeholders without extraction.

options.title: Use only shared media limits
options.body: Document an existing global media/file-extraction configuration path if maintainers decide per-channel suppression should not exist.

options.title: Do not add the knob
options.body: Leave Feishu file attachments as supported inbound media and close only if maintainers decide context growth should be handled by compaction/limits instead.

recommendation.title: Add a documented suppression control
recommendation.body: Implement a Feishu-scoped or shared inbound file-text suppression setting with docs, schema metadata, and regression coverage for placeholders without extraction.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Feishu media hardening commit is the closest code-history signal for this receive-path decision.
